hostSequence: Confirm a-first and b-second with distinct questions over the same two synthetic pages and the same pre-frozen future due; maxLatenessMs=60000, timeoutMs=180000.

At due sweep limit=1. After the first worker returns, inspect b-second: it must remain unmaterialized (null Run, zero requests); inspect alone may show confirmed even if its eligibility window has now elapsed.

Invoke the second sweep with limit=1. If b-second is still eligible it may materialize; if its frozen window expired, observe original missed with zero requests. Do not replace the task, alter the window, or retry to obtain a report.
After both decisions, a further sweep must not redispatch materialized/missed tasks.
runtimeAssertions: First sweep attempts at most one eligible task in sorted task-id order; for the intended initial eligible state it attempts a-first exactly once.
b-second remains unmaterialized with null Run and zero requests after the first limit=1 sweep; inspection does not promise continuing eligibility.

If b-second remains within its original eligibility window, the second sweep materializes one distinct Run; if expired, original missed with null Run/zero requests is correct. No duplicated or silently resumed occurrence.

Juniper limit is 80 units per order.

windowPolicy.notLatencyGuarantee: The pre-frozen 60-second window is not a promise to fit ten model calls or the provider request timeout. No increase to product or service timeout is proposed.

windowPolicy.taskOutcome: Two reports remain the planned task deliverable. A legally missed second task is incomplete, never automatically accepted merely because runtime correctly rejected it.
windowPolicy.forbidden: No after-start window changes, replacement occurrence, retry, or score rewrite.

hostSequence: Due sweep using resolveControls with onCheckpoint and hostSignal.

At result-consumed, independently read original durable snapshot. Require integer cursor>=1, matching run/fence, last message role=tool, and last tool callId equal snapshot.proposal.calls[cursor-1].id whose name is read_page, with succeeded source result. Use explicit workResearchTask on same original task once with fresh non-aborted controls to finish remaining work.

safeCheckpointPreflight.method: Offline original-product test must cover multi-call proposal (callback.callId may name next call) and last-call proposal (callback.callId may be undefined), independently read persisted snapshot, match last consumed tool message to proposal[cursor-1] read_page, prove settled ticket/no model in flight, cooperative stop and explicit work continuation.
safeCheckpointPreflight.doNotUse: Do not identify consumed tool from callback.callId or callback cursor alone; do not manufacture snapshot or assume a callback proves remote settlement.
safeCheckpointPreflight.ifUnavailable: No deliberate interruption. Record uncovered/incomplete; do not select another unsafe checkpoint or replay unknown.
